raw_response:
I will put fertilizer on this wheat plot, but not too much because my land is small and cash is tight. I do what worked for people near me: I will use a little urea and some compost from home, and if I can get improved seed from the cooperative in time, I will plant that because it gives better grain on a small plot. I will not irrigate, and I will not spend money on chemical spray unless I see a serious problem, so for this season I will go without it. Most of the work I will do with my family, and I will only hire a little labor at the busy time.
